_comment: A cheaper alternative to openrouter.json, as a CANDIDATE to measure, not
a recommendation. Use it with: node profiles/devkit.js openrouter-lean
Check it with:                 node profiles/check.js openrouter-lean
Chosen 2026-09-23 from OpenRouter's live catalogue: every model here
supports tool calling (Claude Code cannot work without it) and costs
less than the default profile's model for the same tier. A 'tools'
flag in the catalogue is necessary but not sufficient - a free backend
once rejected Claude Code's tool schemas despite claiming support - so
send one pong through this profile, and ideally run the
implementer-red-green eval under it, before relying on it.
What each tier actually carries in a fallback session:
sonnet - the session itself (the launcher starts there), every skill
it runs, devkit-implementer and ten other agents. The one that
matters: it must hold a red-green loop.
opus / fable - reached only with --model opus. Spec, ADR and roadmap
work is better left for the Claude subscription window anyway.
